philippines.title: PBA: Converge holds off Rain or Shine to level quarterfinal series
philippines.description:
SCHEDULE: 2026 PBA Governors’ Cup quarterfinals MANILA, Philippines–Converge prevented Rain or Shine from completing another come-from-behind and sneaked out a 130-125 victory to tie their 2026 PBA Governors’ Cup quarterfinal series at 1-1 on Friday at Ninoy Aquino Stadium. Mikey Williams’ three-point shot gave the FiberXers the timely cushion and made the Elasto Painters pay for two turnovers courtesy from Adrian Nocum to draw level in the best-of-five affair. Williams’ three-pointer gave Converge a 127-123 lead with 35 seconds left, a big boost for the former Finals Most Valuable Player whose numbers and minutes have been inconsistent. philippines.title: SC: Male victims endure same trauma from sexual abuse
philippines.description:
MANILA, Philippines – An 11-year-old boy fell asleep during a family visit in an air-conditioned bedroom, unaware that a quiet violation behind closed doors would leave him haunted long after the incident. Overwhelmed by fear of an older relative, the little boy complied when his 25-year-old paternal aunt ordered him to undress. He remained silent at first—bound by youth, curiosity, and fear—only to carry a crushing weight of guilt and shame afterward.
